objective: Improve first-observed 99% exact held-out epochs beyond the completed LR x2 short-suite incumbent
selection_data: Short-suite observations only. Previously observed long-suite outcomes are excluded from candidate selection and tuning.

candidates.single_change_from_parent: Increase the learning-rate multiplier from 2 to 3
candidates.hypothesis: The arithmetic and depth gains seen on short may extend to a larger step size; the larger-prime and recall screens test the known short-suite tradeoffs.

candidates.single_change_from_parent: Reduce AdamW beta2 from 0.98 to 0.95, retaining LR x2 and beta1=0.9
candidates.hypothesis: Faster adaptation of the second moment may reduce update lag while retaining the incumbent step size.

screen_policy: Keep original budgets. Require 18/18 passes and improvement in at least three of the six per-task median paired epoch ratios versus LR x2 to advance. Preserve every screen row. No screen-only aggregate geometric mean is reported.
full_suite_policy: Evaluate all 75 paired short cells for every candidate that advances. Prefer complete coverage, then lower full-suite geometric-mean epochs. Compare against both original baseline and LR x2; include all per-task medians/worst cases, slower seeds and censoring. If no candidate improves on LR x2, retain the incumbent and report the negative results.
long_policy: Keep all prior long results frozen. A single diagnostic check of a newly selected short winner may follow selection, never influence it, and must be labeled as reuse of an already observed regression suite rather than fresh holdout evidence.
invariants: Unchanged frozen model sources, task manifest, data, seeds, batch order, dimensions, dtype, warmup, weight decay, evaluation cadence and update budgets; separately archived code/configuration for every new output directory.
